user_approval.exact_text: Approved — activate `R8V15R1-REVIEW-CADENCE-ADAPTIVE-001` at proposal commit `80c3aad923e405dde76e5042248edf0fa8f919a1`, using a 6-slice maximum for low-risk bounded construction and the mandatory early-review/fallback triggers defined in the proposal.

each_slice_requires: preserved expected RED or explicit non-execution classification
mandatory_early_review_triggers: any change to frozen schema bytes or frozen semantics
authority-bearing semantic selection or transition logic
constitutional, policy, root, terminal, or governance authority
resolver authorization or conformance qualification/freshness semantics
cryptographic trust, signature, key, registry-currentness, or revocation semantics
external side effects, dispatch, commit, payment, network, database, cloud, or production effects
cross-slice integration, merge, or dependency authority
concurrency, replay, ordering, idempotency, race, or distributed-state semantics
release, deployment, production, or terminal phase boundary
a new Critical or High finding

adaptive_fallback.recovery_to_6_requires: Two consecutive fresh independent BOUNDED_PASS reviews with zero Critical/High findings after remediation.
